product_overview: DClaw Audit is an AI-assisted internal audit and compliance workspace for managing engagements, evidence requests, findings, controls, risks, tests, and audit intelligence in one system. It helps audit teams centralize operational workflows and generate structured outputs faster across the audit lifecycle.
core_goals: Track evidence requests and their status across engagements
Record and manage findings with remediation details
Build and maintain a control library mapped to compliance frameworks
Create, assess, and update risk items per engagement
Plan and record control testing results and samples
Ingest and triage anomalies and audit signals
Generate and manage audit reports and templates
Review cross-engagement audit intelligence and trends

features.name: Audit Dashboard
features.description: Provides a central hub for audit work, including engagement summaries, evidence requests, findings, and AI-assisted drafting and reporting.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Review summary metrics and recent audit activity -> Open the engagement form -> Enter engagement details -> Submit the form -> See the new engagement appear in the list
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the evidence request form -> Select an engagement -> Enter request details -> Submit the form -> See the new evidence request in the board
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the finding form -> Select an engagement -> Enter finding details -> Submit the form -> See the new finding in the register
Navigate to /dashboard -> Review the findings table -> Update a finding's status -> See the updated status reflected in the list
Navigate to /dashboard -> Select an engagement for AI drafting -> Request evidence recommendations -> Review the generated request list
Navigate to /dashboard -> Request AI risk suggestions -> Review suggested risks, controls, and test ideas
Navigate to /dashboard -> Enter observation notes for a finding draft -> Request AI drafting -> Review the drafted finding content
Navigate to /dashboard -> Select an engagement for AI report generation -> Request an executive summary -> Review the generated report summary
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open the version log for an evidence request -> Review the recorded version history

features.name: Controls & Framework Mapping
features.description: Lets users maintain a control inventory, define framework requirements, map controls to requirements, and review coverage gaps.
user_flows: Navigate to /controls -> Review the control library and framework tabs -> Create a new control -> Enter control details -> Submit the form -> See the control added to the list
Navigate to /controls -> Switch to a framework tab -> Review framework requirements for that framework
Navigate to /controls -> Create a new framework requirement -> Enter requirement code and details -> Submit the form -> See the requirement added to the framework list

Navigate to /controls -> Review the control mappings table -> Create a new mapping by selecting a control and requirement -> Set coverage status -> Submit the form -> See the mapping added to the table
Navigate to /controls -> Review an existing control mapping -> Delete the mapping -> See the mapping removed
Navigate to /controls -> Review the gap analysis view -> Identify unmapped or partially mapped requirements
Navigate to /controls -> Review the control list -> Delete a control -> See the control removed from the inventory
Navigate to /controls -> Review the framework requirement list -> Delete a requirement -> See the requirement removed from the framework

features.name: Risk Register
features.description: Supports creation and maintenance of engagement-specific risks with scoring, ownership, status, and mitigation updates.
user_flows: Navigate to /risk -> Select an engagement -> Review the filtered risk register
Navigate to /risk -> Create a new risk item -> Enter title, description, category, likelihood, impact, owner, and status -> Submit the form -> See the risk item added to the table
Navigate to /risk -> Review a risk item's score -> Observe the computed inherent and residual risk values
Navigate to /risk -> Open a risk item for editing -> Update residual likelihood, residual impact, and mitigation notes -> Save changes -> See the updated risk details
Navigate to /risk -> Review a risk item -> Delete the item -> See it removed from the register

features.name: Anomaly Detection
features.description: Allows users to ingest transaction data, review flagged anomalies, filter results, and record analyst dispositions.
user_flows: Navigate to /anomalies -> Review ingested transactions and current flags
Navigate to /anomalies -> Paste or enter bulk transaction data -> Enable detection if desired -> Ingest the data -> See the transactions added and flags generated
Navigate to /anomalies -> Open the anomaly flags tab -> Review flagged items with severity, confidence, and status
Navigate to /anomalies -> Filter flags by status or flag type -> See the list update to the selected subset

Navigate to /anomalies -> Open a flagged item for review -> Set its disposition to reviewed, cleared, or escalated -> Add analyst notes -> Save changes -> See the updated status reflected in the queue

features.name: Control Testing
features.description: Lets users plan control tests, track results, attach samples, and manage exceptions across engagements.
user_flows: Navigate to /testing -> Select an engagement filter -> Review the control tests list
Navigate to /testing -> Create a new control test -> Enter test details, owner, reviewer, control, schedule, objective, procedure, and sample size -> Submit the form -> See the test added to the list
Navigate to /testing -> Open a control test -> Update status, result, exception count, and notes -> Save changes -> See the updated test record
Navigate to /testing -> Open a control test -> Add sample records with reference, description, and result -> Save the samples -> See the samples appear in the samples tab
Navigate to /testing -> Review a test record -> Delete the test -> See it removed from the list

features.name: Audit Signals
features.description: Enables users to ingest operational signals from connected systems, triage them, and link them to engagements or findings.
user_flows: Navigate to /signals -> Review the current signals list
Navigate to /signals -> Filter signals by status, source, or type -> See the list narrow to matching items

Navigate to /signals -> Create a new signal -> Enter source, type, title, description, entity reference, and severity -> Optionally link an engagement -> Submit the form -> See the signal added to the list
Navigate to /signals -> Open a signal for review -> Update its status to reviewed, dismissed, or escalated -> Link it to an engagement or finding -> Save changes -> See the updated signal details
Navigate to /signals -> Review a signal -> Delete the signal -> See it removed from the queue

features.name: Audit Intelligence
features.description: Provides cross-engagement analytics for recurring failures, owner responsiveness, and cycle-time benchmarking.
user_flows: Navigate to /intelligence -> Review the summary KPI cards -> Observe open engagements, average finding age, high-risk count, and trend movement
Navigate to /intelligence -> Review the recurring control failures table -> Compare failure rates across controls
Navigate to /intelligence -> Review the owner responsiveness table -> Compare overdue counts and responsiveness scores
Navigate to /intelligence -> Review the cycle time benchmarks table -> Compare days open, findings count, and open findings across engagements

features.name: Report Builder
features.description: Allows users to manage report templates and generate, update, and remove saved engagement reports.
user_flows: Navigate to /reports -> Review the report template library
Navigate to /reports -> Create a new report template -> Enter the template name, description, and section names -> Submit the form -> See the template added to the list
Navigate to /reports -> Select an engagement and template -> Enter a report title -> Generate the report -> Review the generated sections inline
Navigate to /reports -> Review saved reports for an engagement -> Update a report's status or sections -> Save changes -> See the report updated
Navigate to /reports -> Review a saved report -> Delete the report -> See it removed from the saved reports list

tech_stack.ui_library: Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui components, lucide-react icons

known_limitations.issue: No authentication or role-based access control — all routes are publicly accessible
known_limitations.impact: Any user can read or modify all audit data; not suitable for multi-tenant production use

known_limitations.issue: API base URL falls back to empty string when NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is not set, relying on Next.js proxy or same-origin assumption
known_limitations.impact: API calls may silently fail in environments where the backend is on a different origin

known_limitations.issue: Evidence file upload is metadata-only; no actual file binary upload UI is implemented
known_limitations.impact: Users cannot attach real files; only text-based version log entries are supported
